keith: quick async — glassbridge private deploy status check. milestone dates slipped? listing current blockers and owners.
anya: pinging networking team for final egress IPs and NAT details. @noah can you confirm ETA?

maria: security is fine with Saturday cutover provided rollback and smoke steps are validated. linking smoke runbook: https://confluence.redwood/sg/smoke-glassbridge
noah: i'll be primary oncall during the cutover, rollback scripts already prepped. rollback command: ```./rollback.sh --cutover-id glassbridge-202503```
keith: thanks — i'll update the rollout doc and mark milestone tentatively GO if the two outstanding checks (artifact sign + ntp) clear. will ping #eng-sre before 01:00 PT. :thumbsup:
anya: one ask — can QA run a shortened smoke tomorrow 22:00 PT to give an early signal?
maria: i'll coordinate with QA and tag @qa-lead to confirm availability.
ops-oncall: scheduled a smoke run for 2025-03-14T22:00Z and will post results back here.
keith: excellent. marking this thread as the single source for day-of cutover coordination. unless blockers surface, i'll close out milestones in the doc on Friday after HSM sign. :rocket:
